text: You said your first word. Nobody agrees on what it was.
You walked across the room and immediately fell over.
You would not go anywhere without a particular stuffed rabbit.
You became convinced something lived under the bed.
{parent} sang the same song every night until you could sing it back.
You and {sibling} fought over something neither of you remembers.
{sibling} kept a secret for you, and never brought it up again.
You learned to ride a bike, badly, with consequences for both knees.
You lost a tooth and negotiated hard over what it was worth.
You had an imaginary friend with strong opinions about dinner.
You started collecting something your parents kept trying to throw out.
You spent an entire summer outside and came back a different colour.
You were told a family story you did not understand until much later.
You broke something of {parent}'s and blamed the dog.
The family got a dog. It preferred someone else.
You got your own room and found it too quiet.
You worked out that money was tight, and pretended you hadn't.
You had the same nightmare three nights running.
A fall needed more stitches than anyone expected.
You read the same book so many times the spine gave up.
